title: S4-NEW-17 — A layered stroke tells the truth.
goal: With a half-transparent upper layer, a red stroke on the lower layer shows through at exactly one pixel blended about halfway (all other 255 cells stay #808080); a locked upper layer refuses a stroke; Undo restores the exact composite.

steps.why: Half opacity mixes the two full layers halfway.
The locked upper layer refuses the stroke.
Exactly one pixel changes: red under the half-transparent upper layer shows through, blended about halfway (about #e04020).

cliOnly: the blended pixel's exact RGBA against an independent compositing model (tests/production/drawingConsistency.spec.ts)
